content.title: USA vs. Venezuela: How to Watch World Baseball Classic Final
content.text: The United States faces Venezuela tonight in the 2026 World Baseball Classic Final at loanDepot park in Miami. Team USA advanced with a 2–1 semifinal victory over the Dominican Republic, built around power in the middle innings and late-game bullpen execution. The Americans broke through in the fourth inning with solo homers by Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony, providing all the offense they needed, given their stellar pitching. Paul Skenes allowed one run off a Junior Caminero home run and six hits over 4.1 innings. The bullpen then took over and kept the Dominican Republic scoreless the rest of the way, limiting its powerful lineup to just two hits. Venezuela earned its spot in the championship game by defeating Italy 4–2 last night in the semifinal, continuing a breakthrough run that also included a quarterfinal victory over defending champion Japan — historically one of the tournament’s most successful national teams. Italy got on board first with a bases-loaded walk. Venezuela tied it in the fourth with a Eugenio Suarez homer. In the seventh, three straight singles turned the game in Venezuela’s favor, as Ronald Acuña Jr. tied it with an RBI hit, Maikel García delivered the go-ahead knock, and Luis Arráez added an insurance run. Nolan McLean gets the start for Team USA, while Eduardo Rodríguez takes the mound for Venezuela. Both struggled in their first WBC starts, each allowing three runs on two home runs — McLean over three innings and Rodríguez in 2.2. The game airs live on FOX and streams on the FOX One and FOX Sports apps and websites. That means you can watch the game for free on your local FOX affiliate with an antenna, or at no additional cost through most existing cable, satellite, or live-TV streaming packages. If you’re a cordcutter without a livestreaming subscription, you can watch the game broadcast for free by signing up for a one-week trial of FOX One on Amazon here.
